title: Queued aggregate VIXEN build termination has no diagnostic or resumable result
body: The first queued command bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent cx-lodperf1 --resource build --label cx-lodperf1:build-base-rendergraph-svo -- bash -lc cmake --build .tmp/lodperf1-base --target rendergraph_svo_tests stopped at [728/1040] with only 'Terminated \"$@\"' in /home/liory/.local/state/undertow/undertow-box-logs/1794637894-build-cx-lodperf1:build-base-rendergraph-svo.log and no UT_JOB_DONE or payload diagnostic. A queued verbose retry of the same target completed in 272s (log /home/liory/codeman-cases/undertow/reports/cx-lodperf1-evidence/build-base-rendergraph-svo-diagnose.log). Preserve the supervisor/queue termination cause and provide a safe resume or diagnostic result for long aggregate VIXEN builds instead of leaving an unclassified partial build.

title: Benchmark queue cadence has no bounded path for a short CPU measurement
body: The queued explicit witness bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent cx-lodperf1 --resource bench --label cx-lodperf1:benchmark-lod-verbose --timing --no-replay -- bash -lc VIXEN_RUN_BENCHMARK=1 ctest ... -V waited because bench-window was idle and the next window cadence was 1800s; its unstarted request was canceled with 143. To obtain the required short CPU LOD measurement, I reran the unchanged CTest benchmark through the exclusive GPU queue as cx-lodperf1:lod-measurement, which passed and reported the number with no concurrent GPU job. Provide a bounded one-shot benchmark admission or a documented fast path for short CPU measurements so lanes do not need a resource-class workaround.
